Class TurChromaVectorStore

java.lang.Object
com.viglet.turing.genai.provider.store.TurChromaVectorStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
Consumer<List<org.springframework.ai.document.Document>>, org.springframework.ai.document.DocumentWriter, org.springframework.ai.vectorstore.VectorStore, org.springframework.ai.vectorstore.VectorStoreRetriever, org.springframework.beans.factory.InitializingBean
public class TurChromaVectorStore extends Object implements org.springframework.ai.vectorstore.VectorStore, org.springframework.beans.factory.InitializingBean
Chroma VectorStore wrapper that adds two capabilities Spring AI's ChromaVectorStore does not provide out of the box:
  1. Filterable arrays. Chroma's metadata schema is Map<String, scalar> — collection values get JSON-stringified (e.g. type=["Animal","Plant"] → "[\"Animal\",\"Plant\"]"), which makes where: {type: "Animal"} match nothing. This wrapper writes a sibling marker entry per array element (typeRT__&lt;hash&gt; = "1") at index time, so equality and IN filters can target each member individually.
  2. Translated Filter.Expression. The similaritySearch(SearchRequest) path overrides Spring AI's built-in filter translation when a request has a filterExpression, so the where clause uses the marker keys above.

Other operations (delete, add when no metadata processing is needed, default similaritySearch(String)) are delegated to the wrapped Spring AI store.
